L2t: Chip Fields appeared in the sitcom Good Times, which ran on CBS from 1974 to 1979, in more than one guest role.
L3t: In the Good Times episode where J.J. launches a new career, Chip Fields appears as a young woman named Rochelle, a name she also used for the recurring role of Penny's friend.
L4t: Chip Fields played Rochelle in "J.J.'s New Career, Part 2."
L2f: Chip Fields joined Good Times as a regular cast member in its first season and appeared in nearly every episode.
L3f: In the J.J.'s New Career two-parter, Chip Fields is credited as Thelma, a friend of the Evans family's neighbor.
L4f: Chip Fields played Thelma in "J.J.'s New Career, Part 2."
